The enumeration defines the tools that can be displayed in the form designer toolbar for creating and manipulating form fields within the PDF Viewer.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldSettings
member.summary: Configures the form field settings in the .
member.remarks: Enables users to add, edit, and customize form fields within the PDF Viewer. Provides options to modify properties such as field appearance, alignment, and behavior.
member.value: Represents the settings for form designer configuration, including customization options for form fields.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldSettings.Thickness
member.summary: Gets or sets the thickness of the border surrounding the form field in the component.
member.remarks:
Specifies the **border thickness** of the form field, allowing users to customize the visual appearance of the field's boundary. The thickness value is measured in **pixels**, with higher values resulting in a thicker border.
**Key Points:** - The default thickness is `1` pixel. - Setting the value to `0` hides the form field border. - This setting applies globally to all newly added form fields through the class. - This property enhances the **visual appearance** and **user interface consistency** of form fields.
**Default Value:** `1`

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldSettings.BackgroundColor
member.summary: Gets or sets the background color of the form field in the component.
member.remarks:
Defines the **background color** of the form field to enhance its visual appearance. This property accepts any valid **HEX color code**, **RGB value**, or **CSS color name**.
**Key Points:** - The default background color is **transparent**. - The property supports standard color formats like `#RRGGBB`, `#AARRGGBB`, and CSS color names. - Setting this property helps improve **user experience** by highlighting form fields. - This setting applies to all newly added form fields through the configuration.
**Example Color Values:** - `"#FFFF00"` - Yellow - `"rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5)"` - Semi-transparent red - `"Blue"` - CSS Color Name

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldSettings.BorderColor
member.summary: Gets or sets the border color of the form field in the component.
member.remarks: Specifies the color of the border surrounding the form field. The border color enhances the visual appearance of the field, making it easily identifiable. This property is applicable only to newly added form fields and does not affect existing fields.
Example demonstrates how to set the border color for newly added form fields in the PDF document.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldSettings.Color
member.summary: Gets or sets the text color for the form field in the component.
member.remarks: Defines the color of the text inside the form field. It is applicable to text-based fields such as Button, Text Box, Password, List Box, and Drop Down fields. This property is not applicable to non-text fields like Radio Button, Check Box, Signature, and Initial fields. This setting applies to all newly added form fields.
Example demonstrates how to set the text color for newly added text-based form fields in the PDF document.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldSettings.FontFamily
member.summary: Gets or sets the font family of the text in the form field in the component.
member.remarks: Defines the font style used for displaying text inside the form field. This setting is applicable to text-based fields such as Button, Text Box, Password, List Box, and Drop Down fields. It does not apply to non-text fields like Radio Button, Check Box, Signature, and Initial fields. If the specified font is unavailable, the browser may use a default fallback font. This setting applies to all newly added form fields.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldSettings.FontSize
member.summary: Gets or sets the font size of the text in the form field in the component.
member.remarks: Defines the size of the text displayed inside the form field. This property is applicable to text-based fields such as Button, Text Box, Password, List Box, and Drop Down fields. It does not apply to non-text fields like Radio Button, Check Box, Signature, and Initial fields. This setting applies to all newly added form fields.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldSettings.FontStyle
member.summary: Gets or sets the font style of the text in the form field in the component.
member.remarks: Defines the style of the text displayed inside the form field. This property is applicable to text-based fields such as Button, Text Box, Password, List Box, and Drop Down fields. It does not apply to non-text fields like Radio Button, Check Box, Signature, and Initial fields. This setting applies to all newly added form fields.
Example demonstrates how to set the font style for newly added text-based form fields in the PDF document.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo
member.summary: Provides detailed information and manages the properties for a form field within a PDF document presented in the component.
member.remarks: The class encapsulates various attributes necessary for defining form fields in a PDF, such as type, Name, PageNumber, and visual properties like Bounds, Color, and Visibility. This class is essential for custom form manipulation and rendering within the PDF viewer, offering control over the appearance and behavior of form fields.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.Type
member.summary: Gets or sets the type of the form field, specified using an enumeration.
member.remarks: The property defines the type of the form field using the FormFieldType enumeration. This property allows specifying the field's role and expected input behavior, such as text input, password input, or interactive controls like checkboxes and dropdowns. Using the enumeration ensures type safety and simplifies the management of different form field types during form design.
member.value:
The return type is FormFieldType, which represents the type of the form field. The available enumeration values include:
Textbox: Represents a text input field.
Password: Represents a password input field where text is masked.
CheckBox: Represents a checkbox control.
RadioButton: Represents a radio button control.
DropDown: Represents a dropdown selection field.
ListBox: Represents a list box selection field.
SignatureField: Represents a signature field.
Button: Represents a button control field.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.Name
member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the form field in the PDF Viewer.
member.remarks: The property assigns a unique identifier to a form field in the PDF document displayed by the component. To prevent conflicts, ensure that this property is set with a unique name within the form.
member.value: A string representing the name in the form field.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.Id
member.summary: Gets the unique identifier of a form field in the PDF Viewer.
member.remarks: The property uniquely identifies a form field within the PDF Viewer. This identifier is essential for distinguishing between fields and is particularly useful for programmatic interactions, enabling developers to target and manipulate specific fields.
member.value: A representing the unique identifier of the form field. This identifier is used to reference the field during programmatic interactions.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.PageNumber
member.summary: Gets or sets the page number of the form field in the PDF Viewer.
member.remarks: The property specifies the page number where the form field is located within the PDF document displayed by the component. Ensure this property is set with a valid page number that corresponds to the actual pages in the document for accurate positioning.
member.value: An int representing the page number on which the form field is located within the PDF Viewer.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.Bounds
member.summary: Gets or sets the bounds of the form field in the PDF Viewer.
member.remarks: The property specifies the location and size of the form field within the page of a PDF document displayed by the component. This property should be set with a valid rectangle area that corresponds to the desired position and size for the form field. The bounds are defined by a Bound object, which typically includes coordinates and dimensions.
member.value: A Bound object representing the rectangle that defines the location and size of the form field in the PDF Viewer.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.IsReadOnly
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the form field is read-only in the PDF Viewer.
member.remarks: The property specifies whether the form field can be interacted with by the user within the PDF Viewer. When set to true, the form field is rendered as read-only, preventing any user modifications. This is useful for fields that should display information without allowing changes, ensuring data integrity. By default, this property is set to false, allowing user interaction with the form field.
member.value: A bool indicating the read-only state of the form field in the PDF Viewer; true if the field is read-only, otherwise false.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.Visibility
member.summary: Gets or sets the visibility of the form field in the PDF Viewer.
member.remarks: The property determines whether the form field is **visible**, **hidden**, or **visible only in print or screen modes**. This property helps control user interactions and enhances the user experience based on dynamic conditions. Setting the appropriate visibility ensures that form fields appear only when needed, improving form layout and functionality.
member.note:
The available visibility options are defined in the enumeration:
– The field is always visible.
– The field is always hidden.
– The field is visible on the screen but excluded from printing.
– The field is hidden on the screen but included during printing.
member.value: A enumeration value that gets or sets the current visibility state of the form field in the PDF Viewer.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.IsRequired
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the form field is required to be filled before exporting or downloading the PDF document.
member.remarks: The property ensures that users fill out mandatory form fields before exporting or downloading the PDF document. This property is useful for enforcing validation rules in form-based workflows, where certain fields must contain data before further processing.
member.value: The return type is bool. A value of true indicates that the form field is mandatory, while false denotes the field is optional.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.CustomData
member.summary: Gets or sets custom data associated with the form field, allowing the storage of key-value pairs in dictionary format.
member.remarks: The property is used to associate custom metadata or additional information with a form field. This property accepts values in a dictionary format, where the keys are strings representing custom data labels, and the values can be of any object type. This flexibility allows developers to attach supplementary data such as user-defined attributes, configuration settings, or processing-related information to the form field.
member.value: The return type is object, allowing diverse data types to be stored as values while the dictionary keys remain strings. This provides flexibility to store custom information and metadata necessary for advanced form processing and validation.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.TooltipText
member.summary: Gets or sets the tooltip text that provides additional information about the form field.
member.remarks: The property defines a descriptive text that appears when users hover over the form field with the mouse or focus on it using the keyboard. This property helps convey guidance, instructions, or validation hints related to the form field's purpose, enhancing the overall user experience and accessibility of the form.
member.value: The return type is string, representing the tooltip text associated with the form field. This text is displayed when the user interacts with the form field.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.Thickness
member.summary: Gets or sets the border thickness of the form field.
member.remarks: The property specifies the width of the border surrounding the form field in the PDF viewer. This property allows customization of the form field's appearance to highlight important fields or align with the design aesthetics of the form. Increasing the thickness enhances visibility, while smaller values provide a subtle appearance. Consider the overall layout and user interaction when setting this property to ensure a consistent and accessible user experience.
member.value: The return type is int, representing the border thickness in device-independent pixels (DIP). A higher value results in a thicker border, making the form field more prominent.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.BackgroundColor
member.summary: Gets or sets the background color of the form field in hexadecimal string format.
member.remarks: The property specifies the background color of the form field using a hexadecimal color code. This property enables customization of the form field's appearance, allowing users to highlight fields or maintain consistent design aesthetics. The hexadecimal string should follow the standard RGB or RGBA format (e.g., "#RRGGBB" or "#RRGGBBAA"). Invalid color codes may result in default rendering behavior.
member.value: The return type is string, representing the background color in hexadecimal format. A properly formatted hex code allows for precise color customization.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.BorderColor
member.summary: Gets or sets the border color of the form field in hexadecimal string format.
member.remarks: The property specifies the border color of a form field using a hexadecimal string format. This property enables customization of the form field's appearance, helping to maintain visual consistency or highlight specific fields. The hexadecimal string should be in the standard RGB ("#RRGGBB") or RGBA ("#RRGGBBAA") format. If an invalid color code is provided, the background color will default to transparent.
member.value: The return type is string, representing the border color in hexadecimal format. This format allows for precise color specification and supports transparency with RGBA codes.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.TextAlignment
member.summary: Gets or sets the text alignment for a form field in the PDF Viewer.
member.remarks: The property specifies how the text content is aligned within the form field. This property is applicable only to text-based form fields, including TextBox, ComboBox, Password, ButtonField, and ListBox. It does not apply to non-text fields such as CheckBox, RadioButton, Signature fields.
member.value:
The text alignment of the form field, represented by the enumeration. For ButtonField, the default text alignment is . For all other text-based form fields, the default alignment is The available alignment options are:
- Aligns text to the left.
- Aligns text to the right.
- Centers the text.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.Color
member.summary: Gets or sets the color of the form field in the PDF Viewer.
member.remarks: The property defines the color of the form field's text depending on the field type. It is applicable for text-based form fields such as TextBox, ComboBox, Password, ButtonField, and ListBox This property does not apply to non-text fields like CheckBox, RadioButton, Signature fields. The color value must be specified as a string in a valid color format, such as named colors (e.g., "Red") or hexadecimal color codes (e.g., "#FF0000").
member.value: The color of the form field as a string. The default value is "Black". Acceptable values include named colors (e.g., "Red", "Blue") and hexadecimal codes (e.g., "#FF0000").

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.FontFamily
member.summary: Gets or sets the font family used for rendering text within a form field in the PDF Viewer.
member.remarks:
The property specifies the font style applied to the text content of the form field. The font name should be provided as a string and must correspond to a valid font available in the PDF viewer. Commonly supported fonts include "Helvetica", "Times New Roman", and "Courier".
This property is applicable for text-based form fields such as TextBox, ComboBox, Password, ButtonField, and ListBox It does not apply to CheckBox, RadioButton fields and this property applies when a typed signature is used. The specified font family will be used to render the signature text.
member.value: The font family of the form field text as a string. The default value is "Helvetica". Acceptable values include standard font families such as "Helvetica", "Times New Roman", and "Courier".

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.FontSize
member.summary: Gets or sets the font size of the text in the form field.
member.remarks: The property determines the size of the text displayed within the form field, measured in pixels. (px). It is applicable only to text-based form fields such as TextBox, ComboBox, Password, ButtonField, and ListBox This property does not apply to CheckBox, RadioButton, Signature fields. A larger value increases the text size, while a smaller value reduces it. Setting an appropriate size ensures optimal text visibility within the form field.
member.value: The font size of the text in the form field, measured in points. The default value is 10. Acceptable values are greater than 0.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo.FontStyle
member.summary: Gets or sets the font style applied to the text content within a form field in the PDF document.
member.remarks:
The property determines the visual styling of the text content in the form field. It accepts one or more values from the enumeration, which can be combined using bitwise OR operations (|).
Available options include: - : No special style applied. - : Applies bold formatting. - : Applies italic formatting.
This property is applicable to text-based form fields such as TextBox, ComboBox, Password, ButtonField, and ListBox. It does not apply to CheckBox, RadioButton, Signature fields.
member.value: The font style of the text in the form field, represented by the enumeration. The default value is .

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.NavigationToolbarSettings
member.summary: Provides configuration options for customizing the navigation toolbar in the PDF Viewer.
member.remarks: The NavigationToolbarSettings element enables developers to define the toolbar layout and behavior by specifying the built-in navigation items and injecting custom toolbar items. It enhances navigation flexibility and allows integration of additional actions tailored to user needs.

example.code:
<SfPdfViewer2 DocumentPath="wwwroot/PDF/test.pdf" Width="100%" Height="100%" EnableNavigationPanel="true">
<NavigationToolbarSettings BuiltInItems="@Items" CustomItems="@CustomItems"> </NavigationToolbarSettings>
</SfPdfViewer2>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.NavigationToolbarSettings.LoadOn
member.summary: Specifies the strategy for loading template content in the PDF Viewer navigation panel.
member.remarks: Use this property to control when and how template content is rendered in the DOM. - Dynamic: Only the selected template is loaded at any time; switching templates replaces the content. - Init: All template contents are loaded during the initial render and remain in the DOM. - Demand: Template load content when selected; once loaded, content stays in the DOM. This helps tailor performance based on application behavior and memory sensitivity.

example.code: <SfPdfViewer2 Height="100%" Width="100%" DocumentPath="wwwroot/Annotation.pdf" EnableNavigationPanel="true"> <NavigationToolbarSettings LoadOn="ContentLoad.Init" CustomItems="@CustomItems" BuiltInItems="BuiltInItems"> </NavigationToolbarSettings> </SfPdfViewer2>

member.value: A ContentLoad enum value determining the template content loading behavior for the navigation panel. Defaults to ContentLoad.Dynamic.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.NavigationToolbarSettings.CustomItems
member.summary: Defines a collection of custom toolbar items that can be injected into the PDF Viewer’s navigation toolbar.
member.remarks: Use this property to extend the default navigation toolbar with user-defined actions. Custom items allow developers to configure tooltips, icons, command bindings, and placement within the toolbar. The index determines the position of each item, ensuring precise control over the toolbar layout.

example.code:
<SfPdfViewer2
                 DocumentPath="wwwroot/PDF/test.pdf"
                 Width="100%"
                 Height="100%"
                 EnableNavigationPanel="true">
             
                 <NavigationToolbarSettings 
                     CustomItems="@CustomItems">
                 </NavigationToolbarSettings>
             
             </SfPdfViewer2>
            
             @code {
                 List<CustomNavigationToolbarItem> CustomItems = new List<CDATA[CustomNavigationToolbarItem> {
                     new CustomNavigationToolbarItem { Index = 3, Name = "Notes", IconCss = "e-pv-Note" }
                 };
             }

member.value: A collection of CustomNavigationToolbarItem objects used to define additional user-defined toolbar items.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.NavigationToolbarSettings.BuiltInItems
member.summary: Represents the available navigation toolbar items in the component.
member.remarks:
The enumeration defines the built-in toolbar options that appear within the modern navigation panel of the PDF Viewer.
These items allow users to quickly navigate the document using features like thumbnails, bookmarks, and comment panel access. Use these values to configure the navigation toolbar according to application needs.
member.value: A collection of enumeration values representing the built-in navigation tools in the PDF Viewer.

member.remarks: The class is used to define user-specific toolbar items within the navigation panel. It includes properties for positioning, naming, styling, and templating each custom item. These items can enhance the toolbar with additional functionality beyond built-in options.

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerBase.SetFormDrawingModeAsync(System.Nullable{Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldType})
member.summary: Asynchronously sets or clears the form field type in the PDF Viewer.
member.remarks: This method allows configuring different form field types in the PDF Viewer. It supports various types defined in the enumeration. If no argument is provided or null is passed, the current form field type will be cleared. The following example demonstrates how to set or clear a form field type using buttons.

example.code:
<SfPdfViewer2 @ref="pdfViewer"></SfPdfViewer2>
             <button @onclick="SetFormDrawingMode">Set Form Field Type</button>
             <button @onclick="ClearFormDrawingMode">Clear Form Field Type</button>
            
             @code {
                 SfPdfViewer2 pdfViewer;
            
                 async Task SetFormDrawingMode()
                 {
                     await pdfViewer.SetFormDrawingModeAsync(FormFieldType.CheckBox);
                 }
            
                 async Task ClearFormDrawingMode()
                 {
                     await pdfViewer.SetFormDrawingModeAsync();
                 }
             }

member.param: The form field type to be set. If no argument is provided or null is passed, the current form field type will be cleared.
member.returns: A representing the asynchronous operation of setting or clearing the form field type.

<SfPdfViewer2 @ref="pdfViewer"></SfPdfViewer2>

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerBase.SelectFormFieldAsync(Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo)
member.summary: Asynchronously selects a form field in the PDF Viewer using a object.
member.remarks: This method sets the specified form field as the active selection based on the provided instance. Use this method to programmatically focus on or manipulate a specific form field with detailed field information. The following example demonstrates selecting a form field using a button.

example.code:
<SfPdfViewer2 @ref="pdfViewer"></SfPdfViewer2>
             <button @onclick="SelectFormField">Select Form Field</button>
             
             @code {
                 SfPdfViewer2 pdfViewer;
            
                 async Task SelectFormField()
                 {
                    List<FormFieldInfo> formFields = await viewer.GetFormFieldsAsync();
                    if (formFields.Count > 0)
                    {
                       FormFieldInfo formField = formFields[0];
                       await pdfViewer.SelectFormFieldAsync(formField);
                    }
                 }
             }

member.returns: A representing the asynchronous operation of selecting the specified form field.

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerBase.AddFormFieldsAsync(System.Collections.Generic.List{Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.FormFieldInfo})
member.summary: Asynchronously adds a list of form fields in the PDF Viewer.
member.remarks: This method allows adding multiple form fields in the PDF Viewer. It accepts a list of objects, enabling batch insertion of form fields. The following example demonstrates adding form fields using a button.

example.code:
<SfPdfViewer2 @ref="pdfViewer"></SfPdfViewer2>
             <button @onclick="AddFormFields">Add Form Fields</button>
            
             @code {
                 SfPdfViewer2 pdfViewer;
            
                 async Task AddFormFields()
                 {
                     List<FormFieldInfo>  formFields = new List<FormFieldInfo>
                     {
                         new TextBoxField() { Name = "TextBox1", PageNumber = 1, Value = "text" },
                         new CheckBoxField { Name = "CheckBox1", PageNumber = 1, IsChecked = true }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerBase.RestrictZoomRequest
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether a single image rendered at 100% zoom should be reused across all zoom levels.
member.remarks: The property helps optimize zoom performance in the PDF viewer by reducing the frequency of image regeneration. When enabled (true), the viewer generates a single image at 100% zoom and reuses it for all subsequent zoom operations. This minimizes client-side processing and enhances performance, particularly on low-powered or resource-constrained devices. However, it may slightly reduce image clarity at non-100% zoom levels. When disabled (false, default), page images are regenerated at each zoom level to ensure sharper rendering during zoom interactions.

member.summary: Represents the method to be called when the designated command is invoked.
member.value: Represents an event callback function.
member.code:
<SfPdfViewer2 @ref="Viewer" DocumentPath="@DocumentPath" Height="100%" Width="100%"> 
                 <PdfViewerEvents CommandExecuted="@CommandExecute"></PdfViewerEvents> 
            </SfPdfViewer2> 
            public void CommandExecute(CommandExecutedEventArgs args) 
            { 
               if(args.Gesture.Modifiers == PdfModifierKeys.Shift && args.Gesture.Key ==PdfKeys.H) 
               { 
                 pdf.FitToHeightAsync(); 
               } 
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerEvents.FormFieldResized
member.summary: Triggers when a form field is resized in the component.
member.remarks: The FormFieldResized event provides information about the resized form field, including its previous and updated dimensions. This allows developers to handle custom resizing logic or restrictions.

example.code:
<SfPdfViewer2 @ref="Viewer" Height="100%" Width="100%">
                 <PdfViewerEvents FormFieldResized="@OnFormFieldResized"></PdfViewerEvents>
             </SfPdfViewer2>
            
             @code {
             void OnFormFieldResized(FormFieldResizedEventArgs args)
             {
                 // Retrieve the resized form field
                 FormFieldInfo resizedField = args.Field;
                 Console.WriteLine($"Form field resized: {resizedField.Name}");
            
                 // Retrieve old and new sizes
                 Bound oldSize = args.OldBounds;
                 Bound newSize = args.NewBounds;
            
                 Console.WriteLine($"Old Size: {oldSize.Width}x{oldSize.Height}");
                 Console.WriteLine($"New Size: {newSize.Width}x{newSize.Height}");
            
                 // Implement additional logic
             }
             }

member.value: An that is invoked when a form field is resized.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerRedactionSettings
member.summary: Provides customization options for redaction annotations in the PDF Viewer.
member.remarks: The PdfViewerRedactionSettings class extends PdfViewerShapeSettings and includes additional properties specifically designed to control the appearance and behavior of redaction annotations. These settings include overlay text, fill color, font settings, and alignment, allowing users to configure how redacted content should be displayed in the PDF document.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerRedactionSettings.TextAlignment
member.summary: Gets or sets the alignment of the overlay text displayed in the redaction annotation.
member.remarks: This property defines how the overlay text is aligned within the bounds of the redaction area. Supported alignment options are Left, Center, and Right. Adjust this property to control the visual positioning of the redaction text.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerRedactionSettings.OverlayText
member.summary: Gets or sets the text to be displayed as an overlay in the redaction annotation.
member.remarks: Specifies the string that will appear over the redacted area. If is true, this text will repeat to fill the redaction bounds; otherwise it appears only once. The default value is an empty string.
member.value: A representing the overlay text to use for redaction. Default is String.Empty.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerRedactionSettings.FontFamily
member.summary: Gets or sets the font family used for the overlay text in the redaction annotation.
member.remarks: Defines the font style of the overlay text that appears on the redacted area. You can use standard font family names such as Arial, Courier, Helvetica, or any other supported font. The default value is "Helvetica".
member.value: A representing the font family to be applied to the redaction overlay text. Default is "Helvetica".

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerRedactionSettings.FontSize
member.summary: Gets or sets the font size of the overlay text in the redaction annotation.
member.remarks: This property determines the size of the overlay text displayed within the redacted area. Larger values result in bigger text, while smaller values produce smaller text. The unit is in points (pt). The default value is 16.
member.value: A value representing the size of the overlay text in points. Default is 16.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerRedactionSettings.IsRepeat
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the overlay text should repeat to fill the redaction area.
member.remarks: When this property is set to true, the specified will repeat across the entire bounds of the redaction annotation. If set to false, the overlay text will be displayed only once, centered within the redaction area. This is useful for scenarios where you want the redacted content to show a repeated pattern of text like "Confidential" or "Redacted". The default value is false.
member.value: A value indicating whether to repeat the overlay text in the redaction annotation. Default is false.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerRedactionSettings.FontColor
member.summary: Gets or sets the font color of the overlay text in the redaction annotation.
member.remarks: Specifies the color used for the overlay text displayed within the redacted area. The value must be a valid CSS color string (e.g., "#FF0000", "red", or "rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"). This setting allows you to control the visibility and contrast of the overlay text against the redaction fill color. The default value is "rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)", which represents solid red.
member.value: A representing the color of the overlay text in CSS color format. Default is "rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)".

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerRedactionSettings.MarkerBorderColor
member.summary: Gets or sets the border color of the redaction marker.
member.remarks: This property defines the color of the border surrounding the redaction area. You can specify the border color using a valid CSS color string (e.g., "#FF0000", "blue", or "rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"). The default value is "rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)", which represents a solid red border around the redaction marker.
member.value: A representing the color of the border surrounding the redaction marker in CSS color format. Default is "rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)".

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerRedactionSettings.MarkerFillColor
member.summary: Gets or sets the fill color of the redaction marker.
member.remarks: This property defines the color used to fill the redaction area. The fill color can be set using any valid CSS color string (e.g., "#FFFFFF", "green", or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"). The default value is "rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)", which represents a white fill for the redaction marker.
member.value: A representing the fill color of the redaction marker in CSS color format. Default is "rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)".

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.SfPdfViewer.PdfViewerRedactionSettings.MarkerOpacity
member.summary: Gets or sets the opacity of the redaction marker.
member.remarks: This property controls the transparency of the redaction marker's fill and border. A value of 1 represents full opacity (no transparency), while a value of 0 represents full transparency (completely invisible). The default value is 1, meaning the redaction marker is fully opaque.
member.value: A value representing the opacity of the redaction marker, ranging from 0 (fully transparent) to 1 (fully opaque). Default is 1.

example.code:
<SfPdfViewer2>

                 {
                    FormDesignerToolbarItem.Textbox,
                    FormDesignerToolbarItem.Password,
                    FormDesignerToolbarItem.Delete
                 };
             }
